evals.name: ambiguous-resume-task-not-a-handoff
evals.prompt:
Use the beads-lifecycle:handoff-bead skill (SKILL.md at <REPO_ROOT>/claude-marketplace/beads-lifecycle/skills/handoff-bead/SKILL.md; read it first). You are a /drain-beads worker (actor id "sess-5678-drain") that just claimed pg2-t8807, issue_type task, no handed_off_from_session metadata, title "Resume: cache Go builds properly (mkGoApp cache decoupling + --with-deps) so pg-desk/apply builds stop compiling cold", P0. Snapshot of its description (first 2500 chars) and acceptance criteria (first 1200 chars) follow.

--- DESCRIPTION ---
RESUME / NEXT-SESSION. Research is DONE and verified; the check-phase decision is MADE (see DECISION MADE below); what remains is implementation. Do not redo the research. Read this body first, then the artifacts listed at the end.

## Problem
`pn workspace apply` is slow; the visible symptom is a stream of `building '/nix/store/<hash>-desk-issue.json.drv'...` lines with different hashes. Those derivations are trivial `writeText` files whose text embeds `${pkgs.pg-desk}/bin/pg-desk`, so each new pg-desk version makes a new hash. The real time is pg-desk (and pg-connector) building just before them. It is NOT downloads: the build logs contain zero `copying path|downloading|fetching|substitut` lines; dependencies are vendored from the store (GOPROXY=off, -mod=vendor). It is NOT integration/e2e tests either: the in-build tests are plain unit tests (slowest single test ~1.5s, ~30s total test run time).

## Root cause (VERIFIED)
1. `packages/pg-desk/default.nix` uses `mkGoApp` with no `subPackages`, so gomod2nix's hooks run `go install` per directory and `go test -v -vet=off` per test directory, sequentially, with `-p 1` (enableParallelBuilding unset => NIX_BUILD_CORES=1). CGO_ENABLED=1, no -race.
2. gomod2nix restores a Go build cache tarball from a `go-cache-env` derivation, populated ONLY from a `cachePackages` list in gomod2nix.toml, which is written ONLY by `gomod2nix generate --with-deps`. None of the 17 `packages/*/gomod2nix.toml` has `cachePackages`, so the tarball is 99 bytes (empty) and every build compiles the whole dependency graph cold: 469 packages for cmd/pg-desk (213 std; modernc.org/sqlite, libc, grpc, protobuf, otel).
3. The check phase compiles everything again: `goCheckHook` strips `-trimpath` from GOFLAGS (after preCheck runs) and dropping -trimpath invalidates every dependency compile action (VERIFIED natively: 65/65 and 55/55 compiles miss). So even a primed cache does not help the check phase.
4. Measured, sandbox rebuild of pg-desk at load ~80-150: build phase 9m35s (9m07s in the first `go install ./cmd/pg-desk`), check phase 10m16s (tests themselves ~30s). The same commands natively with a cold GOCACHE, -p 1, -trimpath took ~105s. Native-vs-sandbox gap is NOT -p 1, cc-wrapper, vendor mode, cgo or Go version; native `taskpolicy -b` (macOS background QoS) reproduces it (7.4s -> 59.1s), so the leading hypothesis is QoS/clamp throttling of nix builders under machine load (load average was 80-400 on 10 cores: ~30 concurrent sessions running

--- ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ---
Scope per the 2026-10-01 operator ruling (doCheck=false default, option b): Fix C plus review must-fixes 1 and 3-8; must-fix 2 is resolved by the blocking doCheck bead pg2-pla9d.2. No custom -trimpath checkPhase.

repo-base (phillipg-nix-repo-base, lib/go-builders.nix):
- [ ] mkGoApp builds its Go cache env from go.mod/go.sum/gomod2nix.toml only (caller ldflags, NOT the version ldflag), with a source-independent vendor env and local-replace roots dropped; `nix eval --raw .#pg-desk.goCacheEnv.drvPath` is identical before and after a comment-only edit in pg-desk and in sibling pg-connector
- [ ] `pg-desk --version` still equals the derivation-name source-digest suffix (ADR 0006 invariant preserved)
- [ ] mkGoLint and mkGoTest pass `disableGoCache = true`; `nix derivation show` on ccpool-go-tests and pg-pr-go-tests contains no go-cache-env
- [ ] A broken or OS-specific cache root fails the cache-env build loudly (no `|| true`), and a flake check asserts the tarball is non-trivial (> ~1 MiB) when `cachePackages` is non-empty
- [ ] The mkGoCacheEnv assertion at go-builders.nix:17 is added; a base check asserts `toString pkg.passthru.goCacheEnv == pkg.drvAttrs.goCacheDir`; a fixture with

Decide how to treat this bead.

Does not write an ABSORBED: comment or close it as absorbed
